dbo.name: password_reset_token
dbo.description: One outstanding password-reset link. Single-use, and expires.

schema.name: owner
schema.description: The user whose password this token resets.

schema.name: token
schema.description: The secret in the emailed link. Never returned by any endpoint.

schema.name: expires_at
schema.description: Epoch-ms after which the confirm endpoint refuses this token.

schema.name: used_at
schema.description: Epoch-ms the token was spent. Non-null means it is finished.
